pages.text: Tin ore generates in every Overworld biome, a little rarer than copper: up to 12 veins of up to 9 blocks per chunk, between Y -32 and 96, most common around Y 32. It needs a stone pickaxe and drops **raw tin** (more with Fortune).
Ore smelts straight to ingots too, and 9 ingots make a block.

Tin ingots are an **armor trim material**, giving a dark, almost black gray trim.

If another mod already generates tin, turn Xincraft's ore off with tin.generateOre in the config.
